title: Professional Certificate Course in Organizational Power and Politics Framework
description: This course aims to make the learner Understand and Managing Power Dynamics, Politics, and Conflict in Organizational Management.
longDescription: Stakeholders. Shareholders. Types & Uses of Power. Abuse of power. Difference between Influence & Power, Dependency & Power. Effects & reasons of politics in organization. How to manage organizational politics. Sources. Effects and Management. This course aims to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of governing bodies, stakeholders, and shareholders in an organizational context. Students will learn about different types of power, how to identify abuse of power, and the differences between influence and power, and dependency and power. The course will also explore the effects and reasons for politics within organizations and provide strategies for managing organizational politics. Lastly, students will learn about sources of conflict and how to effectively manage and resolve conflicts within an organization. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following, Governing Bodies: Power: Politics: Conflict Frame work:
